Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human glycogen synthase kinase-3 beta (CHEMBL262). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then assays on assay_id, then target_dictionary on tid. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL262. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
